known_gaps: Findings F-4 through F-7 of the Phase 3 review remain open. They are entitlement-module defects outside WP-P35-01 scope and are not addressed here.
Migrations 001 and 002 have no rollback scripts, contrary to AGENTS.md §14. Pre-existing; not corrected by this work package.
Authorization: Bearer is not enforced by the HTTP surface. HTTP_HEADER_SPEC.md makes it mandatory but no issuer exists (WP-P35-03). An unverified bearer token is deliberately not accepted either.
HTTP_HEADER_SPEC.md contradicts itself: X-Tenant-ID is described as a UUID while its own example is tnt_<uuid>. Both forms are accepted and normalised; the contradiction needs a decision.
PlatformKernelService remains as a parallel in-memory path superseded by the repository-backed one. Removing it in this increment would have exceeded AGENTS.md §15. Recorded as debt.
The audit write is not in the same transaction as the authorization decision. Acceptable while decisions are not persisted; a defect once they are.

MUT-J showed that test_a_token_signed_by_an_unknown_key_is_refused passed on the signature check alone and did not isolate the kid control. Fixed by adding an isolating test; recorded because it proves the probe set was not exhaustive.
sid is set to the context identifier because Phase 1 has no authentication session distinct from the context. A divergence from BOPEN-IDP-001 §12.2 intent, referred to Kimi for a ruling.
jti is emitted but never checked; there is no replay cache. A captured token is reusable within its five-minute lifetime.
Key rotation is supported by kid-based resolution but no test exercises two live keys.

Migration 003's rollback is not round-trippable alone: dropping CHECK constraints admits rows that then block re-application. Six such rows were committed during the observed rollback window. Mitigated by 003_phase1_context_audit.compensate.sql, which DELETES rows and refuses to run without BOPEN_DB_NON_PRODUCTION=1.
Migrations 001 and 002 still have no rollback scripts, contrary to AGENTS.md §14. Pre-existing and now visible in `db_bootstrap --status` as NO ROLLBACK.

13 of 16 schemas in contracts/schemas/ have no test validating a real instance against them. Only tenant-context, entitlement-decision and usage-metered-event do. This is the F-4 defect class unaddressed at scale: the contract suite opens six Phase 3 schemas and asserts things about the schema documents, never about an instance.
No production code path reads or writes any of the five tables migration 002 created. The tables are correct and unused; the entitlement module still holds all state in memory.

RateLimitDecision produces 9 validation errors against its frozen schema, not 5: five required properties missing plus four forbidden by additionalProperties:false. current_rate is a semantic inversion of remaining, not a rename.
QuotaReservation has no to_dict() at all and lacks four schema-required fields. capability-registration.schema.json has no producing type anywhere in the codebase.
Migration 002 columns remain VARCHAR(64) with no foreign key to tenants(id). Migration 004 aligned the policy semantics but the type conversion is destructive and stays raised as a decision.
